# NNN: short name

- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Status: proposed | accepted | rejected
- Decisions affected: decision NNN, ... (or "none yet")

## Context

Two or three sentences: the problem and what forces the choice.

## Proposal

The design itself. As long as it needs to be, no longer. Mark contestable
judgment calls with "Decision:" so reviewers can target them.

## Alternatives considered

One bullet per alternative with the reason it lost.

## Consequences

What becomes easier, what becomes harder, what is deferred.

When a proposal is accepted, its status flips to accepted and any
product-level rule it establishes gets a decision record citing it. Files
never move; links stay stable.
